classifications: Theory of computation → Timed and hybrid models
statement: The exact complexity status of the simple reachability problem for 1-TBPP is left open. An NP upper bound holds from the (general) reachability problem (by Theorem 11) and PTIME-hardness comes from the emptiness problem for context-free grammars. We conjecture that a matching polynomial-time upper bound holds. Also left open for future work are succinct versions the coverability and reachability problems, where the target size is given in binary. A reduction from subset-sum games [25] shows that the succinct coverability problem for 1-TBPP is PSPACE-hard. This implies that our technique showing the NP-membership for the non-succinct version of the coverability problem (cf. Theorem 7) does not extend to the succinct variant, and new ideas are needed.
